//: The provider. Declares WHAT this repo offers; adapters read from here
instead of hardcoding paths, names and constants.
The split is deliberate, borrowed from the enter-the-matrix theme: the
PROVIDER on one side (shaders, atlas, palette, marker) and the MACHINERY
that mounts it somewhere on the other (a Quickshell plugin, a wallpaper
daemon, a theme installer). A second provider -- another rain, another
effect -- should not force a single line of the machinery to change.
This repo is only the provider. Consumers live outside.

upstream.//: Where the algorithm comes from. See LICENSE.rezmason and README.
upstream.name: Rezmason/matrix

//chain: The full chain, in order. Each stage is a fragment shader.
A host WITHOUT multipass support (hyprglaze and most wallpaper daemons
are single-pass) can run `rain` alone: you lose the bloom, not the rain.
render.//compiled: The .qsb files are produced by tools/build-shaders.sh; only Qt uses them.
render.//uniforms: Shadertoy names, the ones hyprglaze, shaderbg, neowall and wallrs pass.

assets.//: The atlas is upstream's, untouched: an MSDF of the film trilogy's glyphs.

//: How this is offered as a selectable background in Omarchy.
The image does three jobs: thumbnail in the switcher, marker that turns
the live rain on, and static fallback when nothing is running.
It goes in ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/<slug>/, which Omarchy lists
BEFORE the theme's own (omarchy-theme-bg-next sorts by path, and
.config < .local). The marker is '.live.' rather than '-live-' so it does
not collide with enter-the-matrix, which watches for that other one and
would turn its rain on alongside ours.
The versions this port offers. Full parameters live in qml/Versions.js,
which also documents every upstream version left out and why.
Two upstream keys are translated rather than copied: numColumns becomes
fontSize (this port sizes by point like a terminal, preserving the
relative density), and animationSpeed is applied by scaling the time fed
to the shader.

options.skipIntro: false plays the intro: the rain arrives onto a blank screen

//excluded.paradise: ripples plus brightnessDecay and polar space, and it is on the speculative Variants list
//excluded.3d, trinity, morpheus, bugs, holoplay: volumetric; upstream draws one quad per glyph, which a single fullscreen ShaderEffect cannot express
//excluded.mirror: needs a webcam and click interaction
//excluded.nightmare: brightnessDecay 0.75, the one parameter that genuinely needs per-frame state

//: Upstream's 'classic' values (js/config.js), except for the sizing, which
follows a terminal model instead of a fixed column count.
Source of truth: qml/MatrixRain.qml mirrors these; change one, change both.

palette.//: 'classic' hsl(0.3, 0.9, l), already converted to RGB. The fourth value is the stop position.
